description: This file is a Zsh completion script for Git, providing command-line autocompletion features for Git commands within the Zsh shell. It includes logic to find and source the underlying Bash completion script, defines various completion functions, and sets up command-specific behaviors.

methods.name: __gitcomp
methods.description: Autocomplete logic for Git commands with various option handling.

methods.name: __gitcomp_file_direct
methods.description: Wrapper for filename completion with direct input.

methods.name: __git_complete_command
methods.description: Sets up completion for a specific Git command.

methods.name: __git_zsh_bash_func
methods.description: Attempts to use bash completion functions within zsh.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_common
methods.description: Provides auto-completion for common Git commands.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_alias
methods.description: Provides auto-completion for Git command aliases.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_all
methods.description: Provides auto-completion for all Git commands.

methods.name: __git_zsh_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the zsh Git completion logic, handling command context.
